verifiedBy: Read from the 2027-entry panel of the source page in a browser, 2026-09-22. The panel is JavaScript-rendered and a plain fetch returns the 2026 dates instead.
claim: For 2027 entry: applications open 12 May 2026, can be submitted from 1 September 2026, with equal consideration on 15 October 2026 for Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry and veterinary medicine, and 13 January 2027 for most other courses. Clearing opens 2 July 2027 and the final date is 23 September 2027.
excerpt: 2027 entry application deadlines … 12 MAY UCAS applications open for 2027 entry. 01 SEP Completed applications can be submitted to UCAS. 15 OCT (18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications to the universities of Oxford and Cambridge, and for most courses in medicine, dentistry, and veterinary medicine/science. […] 13 JAN (18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications for most undergraduate courses. […] 02 JUL Clearing opens. […] 23 SEP (18:00 UK time) Final date for 2027 entry applications.
interpretation: Note the phrase UCAS uses: equal consideration, not deadline. An application in by the date is guaranteed to be considered; one after it may still be read, at the university’s discretion, against whatever places remain. That distinction is real and is routinely reported as a hard deadline, which frightens students unnecessarily and reassures them wrongly. Note also that 2027’s January date is the 13th, where 2026’s was the 14th — the date moves, and a figure remembered from last year is a figure that can cost a place.
